title: PeopleOS Brief — 2026-07-04
subject: PeopleOS Brief — July 04, 2026 Intelligence
preheader: 12-section daily executive intelligence across markets, AI, HR, and economics.
executive_summary: The Indian stock market saw significant updates and trends this week, while the US stock market ended mixed. Global markets are reacting to geopolitical tensions and a surge in oil prices, with central banks responding to inflation and growth concerns. Meanwhile, AI development and regulation are seeing major moves from companies and governments, with Argentina planning AI-run companies and India investigating the Tata data leak. These developments are set against a backdrop of mixed HR trends, with layoffs and hiring ongoing in both India and globally.
